subject: Implementation runway: Entwine go-live commitments & owners
messages:
From: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@entwine.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Lee <sasha.lee@entwine.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Entwine kickoff — timeline & who owns what

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited to move from POC into a production pilot. We want to lock a tentative go-live window (data plane + chat integration) and map out the milestones so our engineering and procurement teams can plan.

High-level asks:
- Target go-live: week of Jan 18 (flexible +/- 2 weeks)
- We need a milestone list with owners/responsible parties, critical dates, and any preconditions (SAML, IP allowlist, SOC2 evidence).
- Draft SOW and rough cost estimate to attach to procurement queue.

Can you send a short mutual action plan and suggested cadence (weekly syncs, owners) by EOD Friday? Sasha (cc) will coordinate procurement and legal redlines.

Appreciate it —
Alex Byrne
Senior PM, Entwine.ai

Attachment: None in this message

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@entwine.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Entwine kickoff — timeline & who owns what

Alex — thanks, this is great context. I'm attaching a compact Mutual Action Plan template that we can workshop together. I've pre-filled initial milestones based on what you outlined and our standard pilot cadence.

Key proposals (high level):
1) Discovery & access (Nov 17 - Dec 1) — Owner: Entwine (Alex/Sasha), Redwood: Grace/Jordan — deliverable: API keys, IP allowlist, SAML test account.
2) Integration sprint (Dec 2 - Dec 20) — Owner: Redwood engineering (Jordan) + Entwine eng liaisons — deliverable: chat integration + data pipeline smoke tests.
3) Pilot validation (Jan 4 - Jan 12) — Owner: Entwine product + Redwood CS — deliverable: acceptance test runbook, sample traffic.
4) Go/no-go and procurement sign-off (Jan 13 - Jan 16) — Owner: Entwine procurement/legal (Sasha) + Redwood commercial (Marissa) — deliverable: signed SOW, billing setup.
5) Go-live window (target week of Jan 18) — Owner: joint ops.

Cadence: 30-min weekly engineering sync (Tues 10am PT) + biweekly commercial check-ins.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_template_v1.xlsx (pre-filled tab: milestones, owners, blockers)

Can you confirm owners and whether the proposed discovery start (Nov 17) works for your team? If so, I'll add dates to the shared Drive and send a calendar invite for the first sync.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 1) Redwood_MAP_template_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 45KB)

Adding a couple operational notes from the engineering side.

– We can slot a dedicated engineer for the integration sprint (Dec 2 - Dec 20). I'll tentatively assign Priya from infra/serving runtime; she'll handle model routing and KV-cache validation.
– Precondition: we need access to a dev API key and a representative dataset (anonymized) by Nov 24 to validate batching profiles.
– Risk: if SAML takes longer than 2 weeks to validate, the integration sprint will slip. Suggest parallelizing SAML setup and data provisioning.

I'll join the weekly engineering sync and can present a 2-week technical checklist in that meeting.

- Entwine needs an SOW draft by Nov 30 to hit internal procurement windows.
- Billing contact: Catherine Morris (c.morris@entwine.ai). We'll need a single invoice cadence and the billing email added to the HubSpot deal.

All — thanks for the quick alignment. Per Sasha, I've adjusted the MAP and SOW timeline:
- Discovery kickoff: Nov 19 (Grace/Jordan) — deliverables: dev API key, anonymized dataset, SAML test account.
- Integration sprint: Dec 2 - Dec 20 (Jordan/Priya + Entwine eng leads) — deliverables: working chat integration, smoke tests, latency baseline.
- Pilot validation: Jan 4 - Jan 12 — deliverables: acceptance runbook, load test results.
- Procurement SOW deadline: Nov 30 (Marissa to provide final SOW language; Catherine added to cc for billing).
- Go/no-go: Jan 13 – joint decision. Target go-live: week of Jan 18.

Action items (short):
- Alex/Sasha: confirm discovery kickoff Nov 19 and share anonymized dataset by Nov 24.
- Marissa: upload SOW draft to Drive and tag HubSpot deal (DEAL-4831) by Nov 30.
- Jordan: confirm Priya's allocation and share 2-week technical checklist by Nov 20.
- Grace: send calendar invites for weekly engineering sync (Tues 10am PT) and commercial checkpoints.

I'll attach the updated MAP and SOW draft link to the HubSpot record once Marissa uploads her final language. If anyone wants to move the initial engineering sync earlier, say so by EOD Monday.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into motion.

Grace O'Connor
